text.arabic_uthmani: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا

words.gloss_range: coordinating continuation at the ayah boundary
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation, not reset. It carries the listener from the promised sending of rain in 71:11 into the next jussive outcome, so the abundance that follows remains one cumulative response-chain. Because the particle is prefixed to the verb surface, the connection is heard before the first new action is fully parsed.

topics.headline: ayah-opening continuation
topics.summary: The initial conjunction keeps 71:12 inside the prior promise-chain after 71:11 instead of starting a detached blessing list.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers continue the response frame from the prior rain-promise in 71:11.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a prefixed coordinating particle, and the attachment clauses link the following verb into the coordinated verbal promise sequence.

topics.headline: prefixed boundary fusion
topics.summary: The conjunction is fused onto the following verb surface, making the boundary link audible before the verb is parsed.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah start already joined to what came before, with no pause before the new verb.
topics.reason: The bundle segmentation treats the conjunction as prefixed to the following imperfect verb, supporting the compressed entry into the first beat.

words.gloss_range: Form IV jussive extension or reinforcement directed at the addressees through named means
words.root_gloss_range: m-d-d ranges from stretching and prolonging to supplying aid; the local Form IV verb narrows the field to supplied reinforcement and communal extension.
words.prose: {{ar:يُمْدِدْكُم}} ({{tr:yumdidkum}}) keeps the promise in jussive result grammar across the ayah boundary. The attached {{tr:-kum}} makes the addressed group the direct object: they are the ones extended, while wealth and sons name the means of that extension. The m-d-d field gives the promise the feel of reach being stretched and reinforced, narrowed here by Form IV into supplied support rather than simple physical stretching. The near frame in 17:6 makes that support sound like restoration-through-supply, and the single extension verb then opens into the two later making clauses. Its compact m-d-d cadence lets the ear feel extension before the material means appear.

topics.headline: jussive result-chain
topics.summary: The jussive verb has no local governor inside 71:12, so its mood preserves the cross-ayah command-result dependency.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is grammatically tied to the earlier call, not stated as an independent prosperity claim.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the verb as a jussive imperfect coordinated with the prior and following promise verbs.

topics.headline: people extended through means
topics.summary: The attached object pronoun makes the addressed community the object of extension, while wealth and sons enter through the following bāʾ phrase as means or accompaniment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the people are extended, and the resources and sons are the means through which that extension happens.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix as direct object and the wealth and sons phrase as a governed prepositional complement.

topics.headline: reinforcing extension
topics.summary: The root field of stretching and extension survives locally as supplied reinforcement, narrowed by Form IV and the bāʾ complement.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the provision as reinforcement that stretches communal reach, while the local form keeps the sense from becoming bare physical stretching.
topics.reason: The m-d-d range includes extension and supplied aid; the Form IV frame with recipient suffix and bāʾ means narrows it to strengthening the addressees through named supports.

topics.headline: restoration echo
topics.summary: The near wording in 17:6 gives the phrase a recognizable restoration-through-supply profile.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear 71:12 as a restoration-shaped promise, because the supply-with-wealth-and-sons formula also appears in 17:6.
topics.reason: The supplied inter-ayah rows explicitly cite 17:6 with the same supply frame, making the comparison available without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: extension opens allocation arc
topics.summary: The first extension verb seeds the later movement into the two making clauses for gardens and rivers.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first expands the community, then distributes that expansion into habitat and water.
topics.reason: The local sequence places this verb before two parallel making clauses, and the supplied root-pair evidence links extension with later making and river fields.

topics.headline: compact extension cadence
topics.summary: The repeated m and d sounds make the opening verb acoustically dense before the material means are named.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears extension in the compact cadence of the verb before wealth and sons appear.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the surface form and is not contradicted by the grammatical evidence.

words.gloss_range: prepositional bāʾ marking means or accompaniment in the extension frame
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the following resources into the channel of extension. Its range can include accompaniment, means, and causal shading, but the local verb and syntax narrow the active force toward means-with-accompaniment. Because the preposition governs the wealth noun and carries through to the coordinated sons, the two provisions form one support phrase after the people have already been named as the affected object.

topics.headline: means and accompaniment bāʾ
topics.summary: The preposition marks wealth, and by coordination sons, as the means or accompaniment through which the people are extended.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the assets are not another direct object; they are the channel of communal reinforcement.
topics.reason: The bāʾ governs the wealth noun and the attachment evidence extends that complement to the coordinated sons; causal bāʾ remains only a secondary shade.

topics.headline: one governed provision unit
topics.summary: The prefixed preposition binds wealth and sons into one governed provision phrase after the affected people have already been named.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees economic and generational provision as one oblique support unit, not as two detached grants.
topics.reason: QAC marks the segment as a preposition, and attachment rows make wealth its complement with sons sharing the same bāʾ complement through coordination.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural resources, property, or usable material capacity under bāʾ governance
words.root_gloss_range: m-w-l covers owned usable resources, property, goods, and capacity; locally the plural indefinite keeps the provision broad rather than limited to coinage.
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْوَٰلٍۢ}} ({{tr:amwālin}}) names open material capacity, not a fixed purse or inventory. Its genitive tanwīn keeps it under the bāʾ as an oblique means, yet semantically it helps extend the addressees. The same tanwīn also begins the ayah's open-ended provision cadence before gardens and rivers repeat that indefinite feel. In sequence it begins the movement from portable resources to descendants, then to gardens and rivers. The wealth-and-sons pair has wider Quranic moral range, including testing in 9:55, but here the local extension frame makes it promised replenishment.

topics.headline: open material capacity
topics.summary: The indefinite plural names resources broadly, leaving type, scale, and mode of possession open.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is not one fixed inventory of wealth but open material capacity.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as plural, genitive, and indefinite; lexical evidence supports property, goods, and usable possessions rather than money alone.

topics.headline: oblique means role
topics.summary: The genitive case under bāʾ keeps wealth in the means/accompaniment phrase while it semantically powers the extension of the addressees.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the productive split between grammar and payoff: wealth is oblique in case but active as support.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies wealth as the bāʾ complement, and the verb frame makes that complement the supplied means of extension.

topics.headline: asset-lineage strength pair
topics.summary: Wealth begins a paired provision unit with sons, a familiar economic and lineage strength pairing that is locally positive but not morally automatic.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that economic strength and lineage strength work as a paired unit here, even though the same field can become testing elsewhere such as 9:55.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite the wealth-sons pair and 9:55; local attachment to divine extension narrows the pair toward promised replenishment without erasing the broader moral variability.

topics.headline: first item in expansion sequence
topics.summary: The noun starts the four-item spread from assets to lineage to gardens to rivers.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah’s expansion from portable capacity into generational continuity, settled habitat, and flowing channels.
topics.reason: The local order places wealth first in the provision phrase and before the later environmental objects, supporting the ordered abundance sequence.

topics.headline: indefinite abundance cadence
topics.summary: The tanwīn ending begins the open-ended provision sound pattern that later includes gardens and rivers.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first major provision noun enter the ayah’s open-ended cadence.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is anchored in the noun ending, and QAC confirms the indefinite genitive form.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining sons to wealth in one provision phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the first provision beat paired. It adds sons to wealth inside the same bāʾ-governed frame, so descendants are not a separate act and wealth is not a substitute for them. The particle also broadens the beat from material capacity to living succession without ranking one over the other.

topics.headline: coordinated provision pair
topics.summary: The conjunction joins sons to wealth inside the same bāʾ-governed extension frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that descendants are not a new verbal act or an explanation of wealth; they are the second coordinated support.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks sons as conjoined with wealth and sharing the same provision complement.

topics.headline: assets broaden to descendants
topics.summary: The conjunction adds without ranking the two nouns and pivots the first beat from material assets to living succession.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first clause expand internally from property to future human continuity.
topics.reason: The prefixed conjunction is attached to the second noun and functions as local coordination within the provision phrase.

words.gloss_range: plural sons or descendants as a coordinated means of communal extension
words.root_gloss_range: b-n-y covers sonship and building/founding imagery; locally the plural noun selects descendants while retaining built-continuity pressure.
words.prose: {{ar:بَنِينَ}} ({{tr:banīna}}) is the second member of the provision pair, sharing the bāʾ frame with wealth. Its plural form makes the promise collective and generational, not the gift of one heir. The b-n-y building field adds a structural feel: descendants become built continuity for the community, though the local noun remains sons or descendants rather than an act of building. The extension-with-sons parallel at 26:133 keeps this slot inside a recognizable restoration pattern, while 71:12 widens the material side to wealth. Positioned after wealth, it moves the sequence from usable possessions into time and social durability, and the long ī sound stretches that lineage movement in recitation.

topics.headline: collective lineage as means
topics.summary: The plural sons remain inside the supplied means phrase and mark collective generational continuity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lineage is one means of communal extension, not a separate direct object or a single heir.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the noun as plural oblique/accusative, and attachment rows place it as conjoined with wealth under the bāʾ complement.

topics.headline: built continuity image
topics.summary: The b-n-y building field gives the sons image structural force, narrowed locally to lineage rather than a literal building act.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses descendants as constructed social continuity, while the local noun keeps the selected sense as sons.
topics.reason: The supplied dispute and root evidence preserve a building-continuity pressure, but the local plural noun and provision phrase select offspring or descendants.

topics.headline: plural concrete continuers
topics.summary: The sound masculine plural presents countable human continuers rather than an abstract lineage idea.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promise at community scale through multiple concrete continuers.
topics.reason: The noun is a masculine sound plural in the shared provision phrase, supporting multiplicity and concreteness.

topics.headline: parallel extension fields
topics.summary: The sons slot links the wealth pair to later habitat language and has a close extension parallel at 26:133.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sons phrase as part of a wider restoration pattern, especially alongside the extension-with-sons wording of 26:133.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows explicitly cite 26:133 and co-occurrence evidence with wealth, making, and garden fields.

topics.headline: lineage stretches the sequence
topics.summary: Placed after wealth, the word shifts abundance from present capacity toward future continuity, with a long sound that matches that stretch.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the first pair moving from what a community holds to the people who continue it.
topics.reason: The local order and phonetic rows support the transition from assets to lineage within the first provision beat.

topics.headline: extension plus building durability
topics.summary: The extension verb and lineage/building root combine to make sons the durable social structure of the promise.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promise is social durability, not merely numerical increase.
topics.reason: The synthesis row combines the local extension verb with the b-n-y continuity field without contradicting the selected noun sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the first making clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots the ayah into a new coordinated act. After the wealth-and-sons means phrase, it introduces the first {{tr:yajʿal}} clause and moves the promise from supplied capacity toward assigned environment. It also begins the pair of repeated making clauses rather than letting gardens and rivers collapse into one compressed object phrase.

topics.headline: new coordinated making clause
topics.summary: The conjunction introduces a new making clause while preserving the accumulated result-chain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pivot from extension through means to a fresh act of environmental assignment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following verb as a coordinated clause linked to the first verbal promise.

topics.headline: pivot into allocated space
topics.summary: The connector shifts from the wealth-and-sons phrase into the first of two parallel made-for-you clauses.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the list widen from possessions and descendants into made habitat before rivers receive their own clause.
topics.reason: The local sequence places this conjunction after the provision phrase and before the first repeated making frame.

words.gloss_range: jussive making, placing, or appointing narrowed by beneficiary lām to assigned benefit
words.root_gloss_range: j-ʿ-l ranges across making, placing, appointing, rendering, and assigning; locally the object and beneficiary frame select configured allocation.
words.prose: {{ar:يَجْعَل}} ({{tr:yajʿal}}) begins the first environmental appointment. The broad j-ʿ-l range is narrowed by {{tr:lakum}} and the garden object: the gardens are made as assigned benefit for the addressees, not merely reported as existing. Its jussive mood and recoverable divine subject keep one agent moving through the whole promise-chain. Because the same verb-beneficiary frame returns for rivers, this first occurrence sets up matched but separate allocations, and the repeated {{tr:yajʿal}} sound turns appointment into the ayah's refrain. Its wider making language can be heard beside providential making in 2:22 and same-surah making at 71:7, 71:16, and 71:19, while the concrete made benefits prepare the following question in 71:13.

topics.headline: allocative garden making
topics.summary: The broad make/place/appoint verb is narrowed by beneficiary phrase and object into assigning gardens for the addressees.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gardens are not merely said to exist; they are configured as benefit for the addressed group.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the verb as transitive with gardens as object and the lām phrase as beneficiary, selecting assigned benefit from the broad j-ʿ-l range.

topics.headline: jussive agency continued
topics.summary: The jussive verb and pro-dropped subject keep the garden clause inside the same divine result-chain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one implied divine agent carrying the promise from rain to extension to gardens.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the subject as recoverable and the verb as coordinated with the preceding jussive predicates.

topics.headline: active prefixed Form I
topics.summary: The active plain verb with prefixed conjunction keeps agency visible and leaves the making sense broad enough for local beneficiary narrowing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a fresh active act enter the chain, then sees its broad making range specified by the for-you frame.
topics.reason: The surface is active Form I with prefixed conjunction; no passive or more specialized derived form is present.

topics.headline: environmental making field
topics.summary: The making verb joins earlier extension and later river fields, with a providential-making comparison at 2:22.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the garden promise as local environmental assignment, comparable in shape to providential making in 2:22 but narrowed to cultivated space.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite co-occurrence with extension, wealth, gardens, and rivers, and explicitly compare the made-for-you construction with 2:22.

topics.headline: first half of repeated making frame
topics.summary: The first making verb starts a balanced frame repeated at word 12, splitting gardens and rivers into separate appointments.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gardens and rivers receive matched but separate acts of assignment.
topics.reason: The attachment clauses identify two coordinated making clauses with the same verb-beneficiary frame and different objects.

topics.headline: making thread and refrain
topics.summary: The repeated verb participates in a same-surah j-ʿ-l thread and creates a local sound refrain with word 12.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears appointment become the ayah’s central refrain and can connect it with the surah’s wider making language at 71:7, 71:16, and 71:19.
topics.reason: The supplied echo rows cite same-surah occurrences and the exact local reprise of the verb form.

topics.headline: provision prepares address
topics.summary: The concrete made benefits prepare the later evaluative question in 71:13.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the promise of made benefits as part of the speech movement toward the following question in 71:13.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives a concrete next-ayah link from provision to evaluative address.

words.gloss_range: lām plus second-person plural pronoun marking beneficiary or assigned access
words.prose: {{ar:لَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) foregrounds the recipients before the gardens are named. The same addressed group that was the object of extension now becomes the beneficiary of making, so the grammar changes role without changing audience. The lām can shade toward benefit, assignment, and possession-like access, but the local frame keeps it as beneficiary relation rather than the object being made.

topics.headline: fronted beneficiary frame
topics.summary: The lām phrase places the addressees as beneficiaries before the garden object appears.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the gift relation before the gift noun, so the gardens arrive already routed to the addressees.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the phrase as the beneficiary complement of the first making verb, positioned before the object.

topics.headline: same addressees, new role
topics.summary: The same second-person plural group shifts from direct object of extension to beneficiary of making.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one addressed community through changing grammatical roles: first extended, then assigned gardens.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence identifies the suffix as the same direct addressee group while the local preposition changes its syntactic role.

topics.headline: benefit and possession layered
topics.summary: The lām keeps benefit, assignment, and possession-like access active, narrowed by the verb frame to beneficiary relation.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the gardens as accessible provision for them, while grammar keeps {{tr:lakum}} from becoming the made object.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry benefit and possession shades, but attachment evidence constrains it as beneficiary complement rather than object.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural gardens or cultivated enclosures as the object of making
words.root_gloss_range: j-n-n includes covering, concealment, gardens, hidden beings, and covered states; locally the earthly provision frame selects covered cultivated enclosures.
words.prose: {{ar:جَنَّٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:jannātin}}) is the direct object of the first making clause. Its plural indefiniteness opens multiple cultivated enclosures rather than one known estate, and the surrounding rain-and-restoration frame narrows the sense toward earthly gardens or orchards. The j-n-n covering field still matters: abundance appears as protected, shaded density, not generic greenery. The familiar garden-river ecology, including the formula seen in 2:25, is active here, but 71:12 splits gardens and rivers into separate appointments. The tanwīn keeps the garden object in the open-ended provision cadence, while the doubled nūn thickens the sound in a way that matches covered growth.

topics.headline: open cultivated enclosures
topics.summary: The indefinite plural opens multiple garden spaces and locally selects earthly orchard or cultivated enclosure rather than an unrestricted paradise sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures multiple open-ended cultivated enclosures, not one known estate and not an automatic eschatological paradise scene.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as plural indefinite object; the local rain, wealth, and restoration frame narrows jannah to earthly gardens or orchards.

topics.headline: covered fertile density
topics.summary: The j-n-n covering field survives as protected, shaded density while the local noun remains garden.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fertility as enclosed and protected growth, while hidden-being and covered-mind derivatives remain background pressure rather than local senses.
topics.reason: The root family supports covering and concealment, but the local object noun in an earthly provision list selects garden enclosures.

topics.headline: direct object of making
topics.summary: The noun is the object of the first making clause and parallels rivers as an equal object under the repeated frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gardens are directly assigned, not a modifier of earlier wealth or sons.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies gardens as the explicit object of the first making verb and rivers as the object of the second.

topics.headline: garden-river formula split
topics.summary: The familiar gardens-and-rivers ecology is activated, including 2:25, but 71:12 splits the pair into separate clauses.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the strong garden-water formula while seeing that each part receives its own act of appointment.
topics.reason: The supplied rows cite 2:25 and high co-occurrence of the j-n-n plus n-h-r pair, while local syntax keeps the objects in separate clauses.

topics.headline: habitat before flow
topics.summary: Gardens occupy the first environmental object slot before rivers complete the ecology.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah turn extension into place first, then into the flows that sustain and complete that place.
topics.reason: The local order places gardens before rivers in two repeated making clauses.

topics.headline: open-ended dense sound
topics.summary: The tanwīn and doubled nūn make the garden noun part of the open-ended abundance cadence with a thick sound matching covered growth.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the garden word join the indefinite provision cadence while its sound matches the density of enclosed growth.
topics.reason: The phonetic and form rows are anchored in the local surface, and QAC confirms the indefinite plural form.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction introducing the second making clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) gives the river promise its own start. It repeats the clause-opening link before the second {{tr:yajʿal}}, so rivers are not heard as accessories inside the garden phrase. The connector makes the final object enter as an equal coordinated outcome.

topics.headline: equal river clause
topics.summary: The conjunction opens a second making clause so rivers are equal to gardens rather than dependent features of them.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rivers receive their own clause weight and do not merely trail as garden accessories.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the second making clause as coordinated with the first, with rivers as its own object.

topics.headline: visible allocation restart
topics.summary: The repeated prefixed conjunction restarts the same verb-beneficiary frame before the final object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final allocation begin again, matching the garden clause before changing the object to rivers.
topics.reason: The surface repeats the prefixed form before the second making verb, and the local syntax repeats the frame.

words.gloss_range: repeated jussive making or appointing, narrowed to assigning rivers for the addressees
words.root_gloss_range: j-ʿ-l ranges across making, placing, appointing, rendering, and assigning; locally the repeated verb-beneficiary-object frame selects configured allocation of waterways.
words.prose: The second {{ar:يَجْعَل}} ({{tr:yajʿal}}) renews the same act of assignment for rivers. It stays jussive and carries the same recoverable divine subject, so the promise-chain remains grammatically alive through the final clause. Repetition matters: a single verb for both gardens and rivers would compress the gift, but the actual form gives rivers their own valence event and beneficiary frame. With the same frame and a new object, the clause balances garden fertility with flowing channels and closes the abundance list. The familiar garden-river field, including an environmental making parallel at 25:10, is therefore split into two made-for-you appointments. This made-for-you environment also prepares the staged-creation appeal in 71:14.

topics.headline: separate river assignment
topics.summary: The repeated broad making verb is narrowed by {{tr:lakum}} and the river object into configured access to waterways.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rivers are assigned for the addressees through their own act, not simply mentioned as landscape.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence gives the second verb its own object and beneficiary, selecting configured benefit from the broad j-ʿ-l range.

topics.headline: jussive agency to the end
topics.summary: The second making verb remains jussive with the same recoverable divine subject, carrying the result-chain through the final promise.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same divine agent and same promise grammar all the way to the river clause.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as jussive imperfect, and attachment evidence identifies the omitted 3ms subject as continuing from the coordinated promise verbs.

topics.headline: second valence event
topics.summary: Repeating the same active verb creates a second valence event instead of one compressed verb governing gardens and rivers together.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees deliberate assignment renewed for rivers, not merely extended from the prior clause.
topics.reason: The local surface repeats the active verb and beneficiary frame, and attachment evidence gives it a separate object.

topics.headline: garden-river formula split again
topics.summary: The repeated making isolates the familiar garden-river formula into two made-for-you acts, with environmental making parallels such as 25:10.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a familiar environmental abundance field while seeing 71:12 distribute it across two appointments.
topics.reason: The supplied co-occurrence rows cite j-ʿ-l with gardens and rivers, including 25:10, while local syntax repeats the verb for the river object.

topics.headline: parallel closure with new object
topics.summary: The same verb-beneficiary frame returns with a new object, balancing above-ground fertility with flowing channels and closing the abundance list.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final clause as both parallel to gardens and climactic in the list.
topics.reason: The repeated clause frame and final object position support the balancing and closure claims.

topics.headline: making refrain at closure
topics.summary: The recurrence of {{tr:yajʿal}} forms the ayah’s refrain and reinforces the same-surah j-ʿ-l thread.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears appointment as the repeated architecture of the ayah and can connect it with making language at 71:7, 71:16, and 71:19.
topics.reason: The supplied echo rows cite same-surah occurrences and the exact local reprise of the verb.

topics.headline: environment to staged creation
topics.summary: The made-for-you environment prepares the later staged-creation argument in 71:14.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees external provision and later human formation in 71:14 as connected concrete configurations.
topics.reason: The boundary and synthesis rows explicitly connect the repeated allocation frame with the later staged creation appeal.

words.gloss_range: repeated lām plus second-person plural pronoun marking beneficiary or assigned access
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) renews the beneficiary relation before the final object. Rivers are made directly for the addressees, not merely implied through the garden clause. The repeated compact form keeps the same community in view while shifting the object from gardens to rivers, and it makes the final water image assigned access rather than background scenery.

topics.headline: renewed river beneficiary
topics.summary: The second beneficiary phrase assigns rivers directly to the same addressees rather than deriving their benefit from the gardens.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rivers are directly for the addressees, not just useful because gardens need water.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the second lām phrase as beneficiary of the second making verb with the same addressee referent.

topics.headline: access focus at closure
topics.summary: The repeated lām keeps benefit, assignment, and access active before the final noun while remaining a beneficiary phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final water image arrive as assigned access for the community, not detached scenery.
topics.reason: The fused lām plus pronoun repeats before the object, and attachment evidence constrains it as beneficiary rather than made object.

topics.headline: repeated recipient frame
topics.summary: The repeated phrase creates one recipient frame across both environmental clauses and carries the same addressees through the whole benefit sequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one community through rainfall, extension, gardens, and rivers without a change in recipient.
topics.reason: Cross-reference rows identify the suffix as the same direct addressee group, and the repeated syntax gives each environmental gift its own recipient marking.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural rivers or watercourses as the final object of making
words.root_gloss_range: n-h-r includes river or watercourse, daytime, openness, and forceful outward movement; locally the plural object selects concrete waterways with open-flow pressure.
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْهَٰرًۭا}} ({{tr:anhāran}}) closes the ayah as the independent object of the second making clause. The plural indefinite leaves the watercourses multiple and unspecified, so the final provision is distributed channels rather than one named river. The n-h-r field is narrowed away from daytime as the selected sense, even while openness and directed flow color the image; the same root’s appearance as mission time in 71:5 sharpens that shift. The garden-river formula is recognizable, but the 47:15 contrast keeps 71:12's river abundance anchored in Noah's earthly restoration rather than paradisal river types. At the boundary level, the final noun turns prior sky-rain into ground-level flow, completing the arc from material capacity to descendants to cultivated enclosures to sustained water infrastructure, and its final tanwīn and broad ā sounds close the open-ended abundance cadence.

topics.headline: independent river object
topics.summary: The final noun is the accusative object of the second making clause and parallels gardens as an equal assigned object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rivers receive independent object status and are not merely features of the gardens.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as plural accusative indefinite, and attachment evidence identifies it as the explicit object of the second making verb.

topics.headline: multiple open channels
topics.summary: The indefinite plural leaves the rivers multiple, unspecified, and distributed as channels rather than one named watercourse or mass water.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader pictures multiplied watercourses of provision, not a single known river.
topics.reason: The local form is plural indefinite, and the lexical evidence supports river or watercourse as countable channels.

topics.headline: flow over daylight homonym
topics.summary: The n-h-r field includes daylight and forceful opening, but the plural object under making selects concrete waterways while preserving an open-flow pressure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the sense on rivers while still feeling the root’s openness and directed outward flow.
topics.reason: The local noun form and object frame block daytime as the selected sense, though the supplied root-family evidence licenses flow and openness as coloring.

topics.headline: rain becomes ground flow
topics.summary: The final river image turns the prior copious sky-rain into terrestrial channels and sustained infrastructure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees vertical rainfall become horizontal, livable support on the ground.
topics.reason: Boundary rows explicitly connect the prior rain promise with the final rivers as a movement from descent to distributed watercourses.

topics.headline: garden-river formula with earthly placement
topics.summary: The noun completes the familiar garden-river pairing and has a 47:15 contrast, but 71:12 keeps the promise in Noah’s earthly restoration sequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a powerful abundance formula while keeping the local scene this-worldly rather than moving it wholesale into 47:15-style paradisal river types.
topics.reason: The supplied rows cite high j-n-n plus n-h-r co-occurrence and 47:15; local context anchors the image in Noah’s promised restoration.

topics.headline: final expansion arc
topics.summary: The final object completes the sequence from assets to lineage to habitat to flowing channels.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah culminate in dynamic flow after capacity, continuity, and cultivated space.
topics.reason: The local ordering places rivers last after wealth, sons, and gardens, supporting the expansion arc.

topics.headline: same-surah echo and final cadence
topics.summary: The root shifts from mission time at 71:5 to promised landscape here, while the final sound and tanwīn close the abundance cadence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final noun both as a same-surah root shift from 71:5 and as the open-ended close of the provision sound pattern.
topics.reason: The supplied echo row cites 71:5, and QAC confirms the indefinite final noun form that supports the cadence rows.

topics.headline: source descent to distributed support
topics.summary: The final noun and sequence together transform source-rain into distributed capacity, continuity, habitat, and flow.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole promise as a movement from source descent to social and ecological support.
topics.reason: The synthesis row combines the boundary movement with the four-item sequence, and the supplied root-pair evidence links rivers with making and extension.

baseline_models.mechanism: Connected reinforcement is allocated across reserves, descendants, sheltered cultivation, and water channels; the repeated making verbs shift the ayah from transfer of goods to configuration of a durable living system.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase that supplies another furnishes the governing image of reinforcement.
Acquiring and holding wealth supplies the reserve component of the reinforcement.
Filiation and derived belonging make sons the continuity component rather than merely another possession.
Turning something into a state gives both making verbs the role of environmental configuration.
The tree-covered garden supplies a sheltered productive habitat.
A river cutting the ground with flowing water supplies the distribution channel.

changed_reading.before: A list of four added blessings: wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers.
changed_reading.after: A connected reinforcement system in which reserves and descendants extend communal continuity while configured habitats and water channels extend productive life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: The two objects of repeated making perform complementary spatial operations: gardens cover and shelter, while rivers cut open and widen paths for flow; extension joins enclosure and circulation into one habitat.

activation_trace.role: Lengthwise drawing and extension connect the paired spatial operations into a continuous habitat.
Turning something into a state marks cover and opening as configured conditions.
Covering and concealment contribute the garden's protective enclosure.
Opening and widening until flow contributes the river's traversing aperture.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and rivers are two items of fertile scenery.
changed_reading.after: They are paired habitat operations: growth makes protective cover while channels open and carry flow through the covered terrain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding dispatch of copious rain activates the focus roots for water fed by more water and a river cut through earth, turning parallel favors into a rain-to-flow-to-production circuit.

activation_trace.role: Sending and setting forth make the sky's water an initiated input to the next ayah's supply.
Copious emergence from a source supplies the high-volume rain entering the circuit.
Water flowing, swelling, and being fed by more water links rainfall to the focus ayah's extension.
The ground-cutting watercourse gives dispatched water a continuing channel.

structural_cues: 71:11 immediately precedes 71:12 in one future sequence: send the sky, extend you, and make for you.
Within 71:12 the social resources and ecological resources are coordinated under the same extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatched abundant rain followed by water-fed extension and rivers; I infer the arrow rain to channelled water to cultivation and social provision, while a list of independent favors remains live.

changed_reading.before: Rain and the four provisions are adjacent but independent gifts.
changed_reading.after: Rain is the dispatched input of a circulating supply system whose outputs include cultivation, flowing channels, reserves, and household continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier fixed term activates the extended-time branch of the focus verb: material and filial reinforcement can prolong a community's viable runway, but it does not erase the terminal boundary.

activation_trace.role: A prescribed endpoint of time supplies the boundary against which extension operates.
An extended term or respite lets the material promise also register as added temporal runway.
Filiation supplies the mechanism by which continuity can extend beyond one generation.

structural_cues: 71:4 pairs delay to a named term with the statement that the divine term is not delayed.
71:12 promises reinforcing wealth and sons rather than an unbounded guarantee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bounded term and a focus branch of extended time; I infer that wealth and descendants can realize temporal continuation, while the ordinary reading of purely material reinforcement remains more direct.

changed_reading.before: The promise increases the quantity of present possessions.
changed_reading.after: The promise may also extend collective viability across time, yet only within a fixed and non-negotiable horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: Successive human stages and the explicit depiction of humans as growth activate a cross-scale pairing already latent in sons and gardens: genealogical and vegetative propagation are two forms of cultivated continuity.

activation_trace.role: Successive stages supply the temporal structure of formation rather than instantaneous increase.
Human emergence and upbringing as growth bridge personal formation to cultivation.
Filiation and derived belonging anchor the human line of propagation in sons.
Thick vigorous growth anchors the vegetative line of propagation in gardens.

structural_cues: 71:14 places human creation in successive stages.
71:17 uses the growth root twice to depict human emergence from earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged human formation and plant-like human growth; I infer that the focus ayah's adjacent sons and gardens participate in that analogy, while they may still be separate favors without cross-domain intent.

changed_reading.before: Sons and gardens are unrelated human and agricultural assets.
changed_reading.after: They become two scales of staged propagation, genealogical and vegetative, sustained by the same extending provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later making of earth as a spread surface for traversing broad passes sharpens the focus's repeated making: gardens and rivers are usable affordances, configuring shelter, circulation, and movement rather than decorating a landscape.

activation_trace.role: Turning the earth into a state repeats the focus ayah's configuring operation at terrain scale.
Earth as a spread carpet contributes the usable surface on which configured systems operate.
Passing through a route supplies the functional purpose of the configured terrain.
A wide open pass supplies the large-scale channel analogue.
The repeated turning into a state anchors this terrain-scale configuration in the focus ayah.
Opening and widening until flow make rivers functional channels through the configured surface.

structural_cues: 71:12 repeats يَجْعَل لَكُمْ for gardens and rivers, while 71:19 repeats جَعَلَ لَكُم for the spread earth.
71:20 states traversal of broad routes as the purpose of the spread terrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making-for-you, spread terrain, and passable broad routes; I infer an affordance analogy between land routes and water channels, while the later passage may concern travel alone.

changed_reading.before: Gardens and rivers are passive bounty placed in the landscape.
changed_reading.after: They are parts of a configured living surface whose cover, flow, and openings enable use, movement, and sustained habitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact return of wealth and offspring inside an increase-to-loss construction reverses any intrinsic-good model: connected resources amplify the recipient's operative trajectory and therefore can reinforce ruin as well as flourishing.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth supply the neutral amplification operation that is redirected toward loss.
Accumulated wealth repeats the focus resource while showing it inside a destructive trajectory.
Offspring from a lineage repeat the focus's descendants while participating in the reversed outcome.
General diminution supplies the outcome paradoxically produced by increased assets.
Connected supply anchors the amplifier model in the focus verb.
Filiation anchors the offspring echo to the focus ayah's sons.

structural_cues: 71:21 repeats wealth and offspring in the same order as 71:12.
The increase-only-loss frame preserves accumulation while reversing its value.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo and an increase ending only in loss; I infer that resources function as trajectory amplifiers, while an alternative is that wealth and offspring merely identify the influential leader being followed.

changed_reading.before: More wealth and descendants are inherently beneficial signs of success.
changed_reading.after: Wealth and descendants are conditional capacities: under one orientation they sustain life, while under another their increase compounds loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later begetting of only violating, truth-covering offspring activates the focus branch of filiation as transmission: sons are not merely demographic increase but continuity capable of carrying a formed pattern forward.

activation_trace.role: Something generated from another supplies the derivative link between one generation and its outcome.
Deviation from right and rupture of a covering supplies one transmitted outcome named for the offspring.
Concealing truth supplies the second transmitted outcome named for the offspring.
Filiation and derived belonging anchor intergenerational continuity in the focus word sons.

structural_cues: 71:27 links the act of begetting directly to an only-outcome construction.
Sons in 71:12 and begetting in 71:27 keep offspring as the repeated anchor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies derivation by birth and predicted qualities of the offspring; I infer an intergenerational transmission arrow, while the verse may instead predict a category without specifying social inheritance as its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Sons represent the quantity and strength of descendants.
changed_reading.after: Sons represent continuity that carries formation forward, so the value of increase depends on what the lineage reproduces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later increase-only formulas terminate in deviation and destruction, revealing increase as a carrier rather than a value; in the focus ayah, the supplied objects and configured relations give extension its constructive direction.

activation_trace.role: Increase and growth contribute a formally neutral operation whose complement determines direction.
Deviation from guidance supplies one destructive direction for increase.
Destruction, nullification, and breaking supply the terminal direction of the final increase formula.
Connected supply anchors the neutral carrier in the focus ayah, where constructive objects direct it.

structural_cues: 71:24 and 71:28 repeat a negative imperative plus إِلَّا frame with different destructive endpoints.
71:12 coordinates extension and repeated making but fills them with constructive social and ecological objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated increase formulas with destructive complements and the focus's connected extension; I infer a semantic contrast in which the endpoint values the increase, while the different roots may simply operate independently.

changed_reading.before: Increase is automatically good, and the focus ayah promises more of desirable things.
changed_reading.after: Increase has a vector: it is beneficial here because it feeds reserves, continuity, shelter, and flow, whereas the same logic can feed deviation or destruction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads later drowning back into a promise of rivers; it remains anchored because the focus branches explicitly pair water fed by more water with a ground-cutting channel, while 71:25 supplies land filling with water. Render it only as a controlled-flow contrast, not as a claim that the promised rivers foreshadow punishment.

activation_trace.role: Water flowing, swelling, and being fed by more water supplies the possibility of accumulating hydraulic force.
A river cutting the ground supplies the bounded channel that makes flow usable.
Land or an eye filled with water supplies the threshold at which channelled abundance becomes engulfment.

changed_reading.before: Greater water and river abundance are unqualified benefit.
changed_reading.after: The benefit lies in sustained water held in traversable channels; when the same material exceeds the channel and fills the land, abundance becomes engulfing.

strongest_changes: 71:11 turns a list of favors into a dispatched rain-to-channel-to-production circuit.
71:21 repeats wealth and offspring inside increase-to-loss, making resources conditional amplifiers rather than intrinsic goods.
71:14 and 71:17 recast sons and gardens as human and vegetative forms of staged continuity.
71:24 and 71:28 show that increase takes its value from the direction and endpoint it feeds.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already pair support with continuity and protective cover with opened flow; ordered context then activates hydraulic, temporal, generative, infrastructural, and reversal models without requiring one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The rain-to-wealth-and-offspring causal chain may be intended as sequence rather than mechanism.
The staged analogy between human descent and plant growth is visibly cued but remains cross-domain.
The bounded-runway reading depends on activating a less immediate temporal branch of the focus verb.
The drowning contrast may delimit productive flow, or it may simply oppose promise and judgment without revising the river image.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A connected ecology of reinforcement.** **م د د B002** supplies connected increase that sustains another, **م و ل B001** wealth, **ب ن ي B007** children and filiation, **ج ن ن B003** tree-covered gardens, and **ن ه ر B001** rivers cutting and watering ground. The sequence moves from portable/social resources to reproductive continuity, then to planted enclosure and flowing water. The packet supplies the components; the abductive arrow is that each reinforces the next as one sustaining system. The ayah reads as integrated replenishment rather than a list of prizes.

2. **Water is the hidden connective tissue.** **م د د B003** supplies water swelling and being fed by more water, **ج ن ن B011** vigorous plant growth, and **ن ه ر B001** flowing channels. The prior ayah provides pouring sky-water. The inferred causal direction is sky-water → extended flow → thick growth → inhabitable garden, with wealth and children inserted into the same fertility chain. This gives *yumdidkum* a hydrological mechanism alongside its direct support sense.

3. **Covering is rehabilitated as shelter and growth.** **ج ن ن B001** supplies concealment, **B003** the tree-covered garden, and **B008** protective cover. After the sterile self-covering of 71:7, the garden is a cover produced by circulation and growth. The packet supplies both coverings; the abductive contrast is that receptive concealment shelters life while defensive concealment arrests reception. The ayah changes the surah’s cover image from blockage into flourishing enclosure.

4. **Increase can still be redirected into loss.** **م د د B002** and **ز ي د B001** both concern supplied increase; 71:21 later says wealth and offspring increase their possessor only in loss. The later verse supplies the reversal. The abductive move is that gifts are support only when connected to the right governing relation; otherwise the same extension feeds a destructive trajectory. This reading preserves the promise while exposing its conditional mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:21 repeated wealth and offspring but attached them to loss, sharply correcting any automatic equation of increase with flourishing. 71:25 likewise reversed water-support into saturation, while 71:28 recovered household growth as a possible vehicle of trust.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A connected ecology of replenishment.** **Lexical evidence:** `م د د B002` is connected increase that supplies another, and `م د د B003` is water swelling and feeding further water; `ن ه ر B001` is a river cutting ground with flow. **Structural cue:** rain at 71:11 becomes wealth and children, then gardens and rivers; human growth from earth follows at 71:17. **Assigned role:** each output sustains another material or social layer. **Abductive move:** I infer causal connection from sequence; the packet does not state a deterministic chain between every item. **Reading change:** `يمددكم` describes a replenishing system rather than a pile of independent benefits.

2. **Children as social growth.** **Lexical evidence:** `ب ن ي B007` is filiation and derived belonging; `ن ب ت B003` at 71:17 is young people arising within a group. **Structural cue:** `بَنِينَ` is placed among rain-fed wealth and gardens, then humans are explicitly described through plant growth. **Assigned role:** children extend a community as shoots extend a living stock. **Abductive move:** I infer a social-organic analogy from the plant and offspring branches. **Reading change:** children read as continuing communal life, not merely possessed assets.

3. **Shelter transformed into flourishing canopy.** **Lexical evidence:** `ج ن ن B003` is a tree-covered garden, with `ج ن ن B001` supplying its root image of concealment. **Structural cue:** 71:7 used garments to create sterile concealment; here vegetation creates productive cover, while 71:15 adds layered overhead cover. **Assigned role:** garden-cover shelters by generating habitat and food. **Abductive move:** I infer a correction between the two concealment mechanisms. **Reading change:** `جنات` activates concealment as life-bearing refuge, reversing defensive hiding.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Human planting at 71:17 recast the listed children, gardens, and rivers as one ecology rather than parallel prizes. It especially strengthened `ب ن ي B007` plus `ن ب ت B003`: communal continuation is itself a cultivated form of growth.

baseline.text: Sizi mallar ve oğullarla desteklesin, size bahçeler versin ve size ırmaklar versin.

findings.text: Mallar, oğullar, bahçeler ve ırmaklar; birbirinden kopuk ödüller değil, toplumsal devamlılıkla maddi üretkenliği birbirine bağlayan bir destek ekolojisi oluşturur.
Suyun başka suyla beslenip genişlemesi çağrışımı, önceki yağmurdan ırmaklara ve güçlü bitki örtüsüne uzanan gizli bir dolaşım mekanizması kurar.
Bahçenin örttüğü alan, önceki kısır saklanmanın karşısında dolaşım ve büyümenin ürettiği hayat verici bir sığınağa dönüşür.
Oğulların türemiş aidiyet çağrışımı, sonraki insan-bitki benzetmesiyle çocukları topluluğun yeni sürgünleri gibi gösterir.
Aynı mal ve soyun ileride kaybı artırması, desteğin ancak doğru yönelim içinde besleyici kaldığını, aksi halde yıkıcı gidişi de uzatabildiğini gösterir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] The Summons Reaches a Closing Horizon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A communicated danger is already in motion, while mercy opens a bounded interval before its arrival.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The warning behaves at once like an approaching assailant, a maturing liability, and an account whose allotted share returns to its bearer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reprieve stretches inside a fixed term
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A period is extended and deferred, but remains bounded by an appointed endpoint whose arrival cannot itself be moved.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: fixed term or maturity date (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); postponement to a later time (`quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`); rear or terminal position (`quranic:root_000019:B003/m01`); deferral of an affair (`quranic:root_000548:B004/m01`); extended duration and respite (`quranic:root_001407:B004/m01`); temporal precedence (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`); limit reached or crossed (`quranic:root_000955:B003/m01`); event coming into presence (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`); knowledge as disclosed apprehension (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Delay is modeled as added length within a measured span, not cancellation. The motifs distinguish the later position, the act of deferral, the duration being drawn out, and the terminal limit. Knowledge closes the mechanism: what is offered is time to recognize an endpoint, not an indefinitely movable horizon.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] Covering Can Refuse Exposure or Convert It Into Safety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cover changes the relation between an exposed subject and what reaches it, either by blocking reception or by shielding from harm.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same material logic that makes a garment into an acoustic barricade also makes forgiveness a protective cover and a garden a habitable enclosure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pardoning cover interposes a shield against consequence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Fault remains real, but a preserving layer covers it and stands between the offender and its damaging return.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: general covering that preserves (`quranic:root_001096:B001/m01`); forgiveness shielding from the effect of sin (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`); offense with a harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); barrier that repels injury (`quranic:root_001677:B001/m01`); placing oneself in protection (`quranic:root_001677:B002/m01`); restraint and withholding (`quranic:root_000994:B003/m01`); garment as protective covering (`quranic:root_000209:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Forgiveness does not erase the causal scene by denial; it inserts a preserving layer. Shield, garment, restraint, and pardoning cover all modify exposure to harm. This reverses the crowd's operation: they cover themselves from the message, while the offered cover would protect them from the consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A formed being emerges through prior measure, joined structure, staged transition, and sustained maturation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human creation is materialized as tailoring, architecture, bodily support, gestation, and gradual upbringing rather than a single instantaneous event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measure becomes a joined and supported form
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A form is estimated, brought into existence, assembled from parts, and stabilized by internal supports.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prior estimating and measuring (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); originating a created thing (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); completed and proportioned form (`quranic:root_000434:B003/m01`); inward disposition (`quranic:root_000434:B004/m01`); making and bringing into being (`quranic:root_000248:B001/m01`); placing into a condition (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); construction by joining parts (`quranic:root_000156:B001/m01`); composite constitution (`quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`); ribs and structural props (`quranic:root_000156:B009/m01`); corresponding pieces joined face-to-face (`quranic:root_001198:B010/m01`); sustaining framework (`quranic:root_001273:B009/m01`); upright component or implement (`quranic:root_001273:B012/m01`); occurrence in existence (`quranic:root_001332:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Creation has the internal sequence of craft. Estimation precedes production; production joins parts; joined parts receive ribs, props, and an upright frame; and the result takes a completed outward form and inward disposition. The body is read as a measured construction whose coherence is made.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi boyuna çekerek uzatma ve böylece uzanma ya da başka bir şeye bağlanma çekirdeğini açıkça verir. Gölge, bakış, boy, beden ve günle ilgili kullanımlar bu uzama çekirdeğinin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yardım sağlama, suyun çoğalması, zaman süresi, irin ya da ölçü kabı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel uzatma çekirdeğini korur; gölge, bakış, gün ve boyla ilgili anlamları yalnız kendi kalıplaşmış bağlamlarında ele alır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi boyuna çekerek uzunluğunu veya yayılımını artırmak, böylece onun uzanmasını ya da başka bir şeye ulaşarak bağlanmasını sağlamaktır. Bedenin gerinmesi, bakışın uzağa yönelmesi ve günün yükselmesi bu uzama tasarımına bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi boyuna çekip uzunluğunu veya yayılımını artırarak uzatmak ya da bağlantılı hâle getirmektir.
Aynı çekirdek, bir şeyin kendiliğinden uzaması, bedenin gerinmesi, uzun boy ve uzağa erişen bakış için kullanılır.
Gölgenin yayılması ve günün yükselip ilerlemesi, uzama görüntüsüne bağlı bağlamsal kullanımlardır.
